landing_faq_contribute_a: Read CONTRIBUTING.md in the repo. Local setup is three commands and takes about two minutes.
landing_faq_free_a: Yes. AGPL-3 means the code is free to use, modify and deploy. Running it on your own infrastructure for your own users is always free. If you change the code and let others use it, by download or over the network, you share your changes under the same licence.

landing_faq_import_q: Can I import my existing board?
